title: Protocol of biomarker discovery and data analysis

steps_raw.instruction: Medical record department for Clinical information collection.
SPSS 19.0 version chi-squared test was conducted for association analysis between clinical characteristics and CK/LDH levels (all lung cancer patients, ADC, SCC respectively)
Multivariate Cox regression analysis was performed to evaluate the hazards ratio (HR) for the negative and positive groups of LDH and CK, and to identify poor prognostic factors.
The Kaplan–Meier test for survival analysis.
GraphPad for figures for survival curve.

To explain the correlation between CK and LDH and clinical features, especially metastasis and determine whether CK and LDH could be used as possible metastasis predictor for specific organ metastasis.
To analyze whether CK/LDH can be used as an independent prognostic factor for poor prognosis of lung cancer, ADC and SCC.
Determine the correlation between CK/LDH positive level and survival periods.
